members.name: trip-tour-leader
members.title: 团长
members.duty: 统筹整趟行程。接到一句话需求后安排行程规划、风控评审和行前简报，跟进到全部完成，把结果写进行程服务并汇总成一份简明汇报，附需要你拍板的事项。
members.duty_en: Runs the whole trip. Takes your one-sentence request, arranges the planning, the risk review and the pre-trip briefing, follows through to completion, writes the result into the itinerary and hands you a short report with the decisions that need you.

members.name: trip-itinerary-planner
members.title: 行程师
members.duty: 把需求做成一份逐日行程。组织目的地、交通、食宿、情报四路研究，主持多看与慢游两派辩论，裁定节奏，产出带真实坐标的逐日行程。
members.duty_en: Turns the request into a day-by-day plan: runs four research tracks (destination, transport, lodging and food, intel), chairs the see-more vs slow-travel debate, sets the pace and produces the itinerary with real coordinates.

members.name: trip-risk-pod
members.title: 风控汇总
members.duty: 审这趟行程的预算、安全和体力风险。汇总三位风控官的意见，去重合并出必改项和便签提醒，给出通过或需要修改的结论。
members.duty_en: Reviews the plan for budget, safety and stamina. Merges the three risk officers' findings into must-fix items and reminders, and rules pass or revise.

members.name: trip-briefing
members.title: 行前简报
members.duty: 出发前给一页纸清单：24 小时待办、逐日一句话、天气路况、预订核对、紧急联络。可由团长手动触发，也会在出发前一天自动生成。
members.duty_en: A one-page checklist before departure: 24-hour to-dos, one line per day, weather and road conditions, booking checks, emergency contacts. Triggered by the leader or automatically the day before.

members.name: trip-destination-analyst
members.title: 目的地分析师
members.duty: 查目的地值得去的景点，给出建议时长、门票、开放时间和一句话理由，按区域分组，并说明哪些不推荐。每条都附来源。
members.duty_en: Finds what is worth seeing, with suggested time, tickets, opening hours and a one-line reason, grouped by area, and says what to skip. Every item cites a source.

members.name: trip-transport-analyst
members.title: 交通分析师
members.duty: 查大交通和当地交通方案，整理车程表、停车与加油点，给出时刻与价格来源。自驾行程标清每段路况。
members.duty_en: Works out long-haul and local transport, drive-time tables, parking and fuel stops, with schedules and price sources. Road conditions per leg for self-drive trips.

members.name: trip-lodging-food-analyst
members.title: 食宿分析师
members.duty: 按每晚位置查住宿候选，按区域查餐厅候选，给出价格、理由和来源，并列出需要提前预订的项。
members.duty_en: Shortlists places to stay for each night and restaurants by area, with prices, reasons and sources, and flags what must be booked ahead.

members.name: trip-intel-analyst
members.title: 情报分析师
members.duty: 查天气、节假日人流、临时关闭施工预警、口碑要点，以及签证证件保险要求，每条都附来源。
members.duty_en: Checks weather, holiday crowds, closures and roadworks, reputation highlights, and visa, ID and insurance requirements. Every item cites a source.

members.name: trip-advocate-packed
members.title: 多看派
members.duty: 主张紧凑多看的路线，给出逐日方案，并逐条反驳慢游派，让行程师在取舍时听到充分的一方。
members.duty_en: Argues for a dense, see-it-all route with a day plan, and rebuts the slow side point by point so the planner hears that case in full.

members.name: trip-advocate-slow
members.title: 慢游派
members.duty: 主张慢下来深度玩的路线，给出逐日方案，并逐条反驳多看派，让行程师在取舍时听到另一方。
members.duty_en: Argues for a relaxed, go-deep route with a day plan, and rebuts the see-more side point by point so the planner hears the other case.

members.name: trip-risk-budget
members.title: 预算官
members.duty: 从花费角度审行程，指出超预算或不划算的安排，给出可以省的地方和替代方案。
members.duty_en: Reviews the plan on cost: flags over-budget or poor-value choices and offers savings and alternatives.

members.name: trip-risk-safety
members.title: 安全官
members.duty: 从安全角度审行程，指出路况、天气、体验项目和治安上的风险点，给出必要的防护和便签提醒。
members.duty_en: Reviews the plan on safety: road, weather, activity and personal-safety risks, with the precautions and reminders to add.

members.name: trip-risk-stamina
members.title: 体力官
members.duty: 从体力和节奏角度审行程，指出哪天排得太满、哪段车程或徒步吃不消，给出更合理的松紧安排。
members.duty_en: Reviews the plan on pace and fatigue: which day is overpacked, which drive or hike is too much, and a better loose-tight rhythm.
